entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea

entries.dialogueText: "Very well."

entries.dialogueText: In addition to the military officers, their assistants were spread out around the room. They stopped their chatter immediately and saluted me.

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "At ease, gentlemen."
entries.menuText: "At ease, gentlemen."

entries.dialogueText: I took a look around. After my order to purge the general staff, I couldn't recognise many of the faces. These generals were certainly younger than their predecessors.

entries.dialogueText: Iosef was standing over the table, arranging tokens atop an oversized map of Sordland and Rumburg. He walked up to me and saluted.

entries.dialogueText: "Silence!"

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Mr. President. May I begin?""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. May I begin?"

entries.title: Narrator: "The chattering among the staff bega..."
entries.dialogueText: The chattering among the staff began again. Iosef extended the pointer and loudly hit the map on the table right in its center.

entries.dialogueText: "Everyone in this room has read the reports that the Queen of Rumburg is getting ready for a nationwide speech in two weeks."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger

entries.dialogueText: "The time has come."

entries.dialogueText: "The time has come."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea

entries.dialogueText: "I am announcing 'Operation Fallen Crown'."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea

entries.menuText: "What are you doing here?"

entries.speaker: Player

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "We don't even have enough reserves to fill potential weaknesses."

entries.dialogueText: "All thanks to you. You were the one who pushed President Rayne to remove mandatory conscription."

entries.dialogueText: "If we choose to assault Tzarsbourgh, our first step will be to have our bombers strike them on the frontline."

entries.dialogueText: "Then our tanks will come in and puncture their defense at Crimsrad, followed up by our soldiers."

entries.dialogueText: "Then our tanks will come in and puncture their defense at Crimsrad, followed up by our soldiers."

entries.dialogueText: "After we penetrate their line, we will race for Tzarsbourgh, threatening an encirclement of their forces."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Which all sounds much easier than..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which all sounds much easier than it is."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea

entries.dialogueText: "Let me remind you that we are butting heads with an army far larger than ours."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea

entries.dialogueText: "They can cover weaknesses in their line rapidly. Which will leave our troops that are pushing through isolated."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""You are forgetting that we will ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are forgetting that we will have the element of surprise."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""We should strike first when the en..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should strike first when the enemy has yet to organize a proper defense."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""Their sky will be filled with Sord..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their sky will be filled with Sordland's bombers and fighters. We will have air superiority."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""With our expanded air fleet, we ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "With our expanded air fleet, we can launch a carpet of bomb strikes on them."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""General Kruger, I want to remind t..."
entries.dialogueText: "General Kruger, I want to remind that you were against modernizing our air force at first. Now you see its benefits."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""Our modernized airforce has the ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our modernized airforce has the capacity to accurately strike at the strategic targets across the battlefield."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""I simply use the tools I have, Ios..."
entries.dialogueText: "I simply use the tools I have, Iosef. As any good general would."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""With what airforce? We'll be overw..."
entries.dialogueText: "With what airforce? We'll be overwhelmed by Rumburg's planes the moment they take off."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Without air superiority, our troop..."
entries.dialogueText: "Without air superiority, our troops will have a tough time on the field."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Do I have to remind you that even..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do I have to remind you that even with our airforce expanded, Rumburg's fleet will still be equal to or larger than ours?"

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""The Queen has ensured her royal su..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Queen has ensured her royal submarines are under state secrecy. Thus, our intelligence officers are having a hard time spotting them."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""We will feint at an assault on Cri..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will feint at an assault on Crimsrad, with the full intention of tricking the enemy."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""They are a police force, Valken. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are a police force, Valken. Their skills will certainly be of use during the war, but they shouldn't join the front line as common soldiers."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""The gendarmerie can be deployed on..."
entries.dialogueText: "The gendarmerie can be deployed on the mainline as well to support the war effort."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Casualties are expected to a certa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Casualties are expected to a certain extent, so that Rumburg does not become suspicious of our real intentions. When they believe they are winning, they will push for Estord."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""With their confidence so high, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "With their confidence so high, they'll never expect the 2nd army from the east and the 6th army from the west which are holding their striking positions. At the moment they capture Estord, we'll pull the trigger."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Our bombers will strike at the log..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our bombers will strike at the logistical hubs behind them. After which we will attack Estord from all three sides, destroying the enemy forces."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""Are you mad, General?! Letting Rum..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you mad, General?! Letting Rumburg's invaders into Sordland?"

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Our modernized army is trained and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our modernized army is trained and equipped for such a task."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""I am confident that we will achiev..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am confident that we will achieve complete victory with my strategy."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""Might as well invite the Queen to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Might as well invite the Queen to tea in Holsord while you're at it."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""Furthermore, our reservists are ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore, our reservists are new soldiers. News of the initial defeat will damage their morale. Which might collapse our eastern front in Agnland."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""That is why I advised us to remove..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is why I advised us to remove mandatory conscription."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Can't we just let our troops know..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can't we just let our troops know the attack is a distraction?"
entries.menuText: "Can't we just let our troops know the attack is a distraction?"

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "Why don't we have the generals let them in on the strategy?"
entries.menuText: "Why don't we have the generals let them in on the strategy?"

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "Maybe the defeat will raise the stakes for them. Inspire them to fight harder."
entries.menuText: "Maybe the defeat will raise the stakes for them. Inspire them to fight harder."

entries.dialogueText: "And jeopardize the whole plan by having it leak to Rumburg's spies?"

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""No, Mr. President, it is too risky.""

entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""However, with two of their largest..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, with two of their largest cities under our control, we can lay out a defensive line and force Rumburg to capitulate, since their economy would slowly crumble afterwards."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""However, with two of their largest..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, with two of their largest cities in our hand, we can lay out a defensive line."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""It is decided then.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is decided then."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""It is decided then.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is decided then."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""You are wasting an opportunity to..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are wasting an opportunity to end this war once and for all, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""I'm warning you, if Rumburg listen..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm warning you, if Rumburg listens to their well-trained officers, this plan will not work."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""It is decided, Iosef.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is decided, Iosef."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""I'm adding it to our battle plan.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm adding it to our battle plan."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Now, let us decide on our allies'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, let us decide on our allies' movements during this phase."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""What should the Wehlen army do?""
entries.dialogueText: "What should the Wehlen army do?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Have them attack Dome.""
entries.dialogueText: "Have them attack Dome."
entries.menuText: "Have them attack Dome."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Have them stay in Tzarsbourgh to c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have them stay in Tzarsbourgh to cover our back."
entries.menuText: "Have them stay in Tzarsbourgh to cover our back."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""What about Lespia's armies?""
entries.dialogueText: "What about Lespia's armies?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lespia's impressive army will do w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia's impressive army will do well in guarding our flanks. That should be their positioning."
entries.menuText: "Lespia's impressive army will do well in guarding our flanks. That should be their positioning."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lespia can surely take Dome within..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia can surely take Dome within a week. Let's coordinate with them on that."
entries.menuText: "Lespia can surely take Dome within a week. Let's coordinate with them on that."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Agnolia will probably try to assau..."
entries.dialogueText: "Agnolia will probably try to assault Dome after they have finished assisting us in the pincer attack."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Agnolia will probably still be str..."
entries.dialogueText: "Agnolia will probably still be struggling to take Dome at this point."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""At this point, Valgsland will alre..."
entries.dialogueText: "At this point, Valgsland will already have created a foothold at the north-eastern coast of Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Since the Valgsland army would be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Since the Valgsland army would be poised to act, where should we send them next?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Valgsland can surely take Dome wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Valgsland can surely take Dome within a week."
entries.menuText: "Valgsland can surely take Dome within a week."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's have them guard our flanks.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's have them guard our flanks."
entries.menuText: "Let's have them guard our flanks."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""And that, gentlemen, is our plan a..."
entries.dialogueText: "And that, gentlemen, is our plan against Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef handed me the order and waite..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef handed me the order and waited for me to sign the document.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Its title was "Operation Fallen Cro..."
entries.dialogueText: Its title was "Operation Fallen Crown".

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I signed off on Operation Fallen Cr..."
entries.dialogueText: I signed off on Operation Fallen Crown.
entries.menuText: Sign off on it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to the generals in the ro..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to the generals in the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The generals saluted and the War Ro..."
entries.dialogueText: The generals saluted and the War Room dispersed to begin the preparations.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Valken turned to the generals in th..."
entries.dialogueText: Valken turned to the generals in the room.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""That makes it official, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "That makes it official, then."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""We have work to do. Get back to yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have work to do. Get back to your posts immediately."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""We have work to do. Get back to yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have work to do. Get back to your posts immediately."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Mr. President. We will need your e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. We will need your executive order to mobilize the forces."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""We only have one chance at victory.""
entries.dialogueText: "We only have one chance at victory."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""If we falter at any point during t..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we falter at any point during this war, it will be the end of Sordland as we know it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Only three people were left in the..."
entries.dialogueText: Only three people were left in the room. Me, Deivid and the Colonel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Only two people were left in the ro..."
entries.dialogueText: Only two people were left in the room. Me and Deivid.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Only two people were left in the ro..."
entries.dialogueText: Only two people were left in the room. Me and Colonel Soll.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Deivid approached me."
entries.dialogueText: Deivid approached me.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Win or lose, this will be my last..."
entries.dialogueText: "Win or lose, this will be my last great contribution to my country."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Let's protect our Republic, Anton.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's protect our Republic, Anton."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That is our job, and we will succe..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is our job, and we will succeed."
entries.menuText: "That is our job, and we will succeed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""For our Republic.""
entries.dialogueText: "For our Republic."
entries.menuText: "For our Republic."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will continue to do so until my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will continue to do so until my last breath, Deivid."
entries.menuText: "I will continue to do so until my last breath, Deivid."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Deivid gave me a tired smile."
entries.dialogueText: Deivid gave me a tired smile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He warmly shook my hand before movi..."
entries.dialogueText: He warmly shook my hand before moving toward the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Colonel and I turned to face ea..."
entries.dialogueText: The Colonel and I turned to face each other.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Colonel. For being here.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Colonel. For being here."
entries.menuText: "Thank you, Colonel. For being here."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""When will you trust me to lead on..."
entries.dialogueText: "When will you trust me to lead on my own, Colonel?"
entries.menuText: "When will you trust me to lead on my own, Colonel?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Well? Did I make you proud?""
entries.dialogueText: "Well? Did I make you proud?"
entries.menuText: "Well? Did I make you proud?"

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Where else would I be? A good lead..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where else would I be? A good leader is always there for his country in times of need."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Trust must be earned, Anton. But t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Trust must be earned, Anton. But the crucible of war may make a leader out of you yet."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Let's hope that the next time we m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's hope that the next time we meet, it will be under a Sordish Flag in Tzarsbourgh."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Rest assured, it will be.""
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured, it will be."
entries.menuText: "Rest assured, it will be."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Ha. When we win, I will personally..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ha. When we win, I will personally invite you to supper in Thornbourgh."
entries.menuText: "Ha. When we win, I will personally invite you to supper in Thornbourgh."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""God willing.""
entries.dialogueText: "God willing."
entries.menuText: "God willing."

entries.dialogueText: I stood there alone in the war room, looking at the map of Sordland laid out on the table. I picked up one of the little metal tokens on it and turned it over in my hand.

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""Our planes will bomb them to smith..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our planes will bomb them to smithereens!"

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Any questions, Mr. President?""
entries.dialogueText: "Any questions, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""But we have to consider the defens..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we have to consider the defenses in and around the city of Dome. Ever since they took it from Agnolia, they have been building up fortifications in case of an Agnolian attempt at retaking the city."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Furthermore, due to the length of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore, due to the length of the operation to take Tzarsbourgh, they would come to the realization that Dome is our next target."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""There is no guarantee that we can..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is no guarantee that we can take a well-reinforced and fortified city while holding the line at the western and the northern fronts."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""Especially around Dome. They took..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially around Dome. They took it from Agnolia because of the oil fields surrounding it. Their industrial sector has since heavily relied on them."

entries.speaker: Valken Kruger
entries.title: Valken Kruger: ""With their oil supply cut, they wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "With their oil supply cut, they won't have the fuel for their huge war machine and their economy will slowly collapse. We will be effectively choking them until they capitulate."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Also, we can deploy our reserve in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Also, we can deploy our reserve in Tzarsbourgh to help with the defense there."
